note: RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python tools/research/phase7/full_online_cost.py         --binary target/release/axisforge --dev research/phase6/dev_parts.json --catalogues cat80/ --store store.json         --projects POOL --sweep research/phase7/results/sweep_v2_extended.json.gz --parts 60 --out full_online_costs.json         [--dino-checkpoint models/dinov3-timm-vits16 ...]  One thread, nothing else running, parts in a seeded random order, methods in a random order per part. For every part and method, the pipeline as implemented today:     T_total = T_candidates (axisforge research-candidates, a separate process)             + T_features (Python) + T_inference (models) + T_prior_file             + T_plan (axisforge plan --nr-grasps 1 --prior, a separate process, with its stage timings) M0 has no prior: T_total = T_plan. The first call of each (part, method) is 'first', the next three 'repeat' (file cache warm). Because the prior needs the candidates before planning, the planner generates them twice; 'integrated' subtracts the planner's own generation time to estimate a single-process implementation (an engineering estimate, reported separately). Render + DINOv3 encoding of a new part is timed separately (Phase V recipe: 16 views at 96 px) as the extra cost a visual prior would add. Unit: the part. Models (P(F): gradient boosting on the 316 development parts; P(H|F): gradient boosting on the 151) are trained before timing and are not part of the online cost.
